title: Perplexity Games Escape Room
specs: Multi-room escape games with high-tech features and period furnishings for immersive experience.
Located in historic Ohio City neighborhood near downtown Cleveland with nearby restaurants and breweries.
Rated #1 Fun Thing to Do in Cleveland by TripAdvisor.
Recommended minimum age 12; under 16 must be accompanied by a parent.
Children under 6 not permitted unless in stroller or sling carrier.
No outside knowledge required; reading glasses recommended if normally used.
All games are private at no extra cost; minimum 3 players on busier days with 2-player option available Tue-Thur.
Capacity limits apply per game; Sunday Matinee allows any number up to capacity at flat rate.
Corporate events can accommodate up to 50 people with multiple rooms or back-to-back sessions.
includes: Private game with just your group, no strangers added.
Premium quality experience with multi-room games and immersive sets.
Game master support and explanation before play.
gap: Exact maximum group size per individual game not stated
blurb: Guests enter themed, real-life rooms with a single mission and 60 minutes to solve puzzles, find clues, and complete an interactive adventure game. Games feature multi-room setups with high-tech features and period furnishings for full immersion. Suitable for families, friends, corporate groups, and special events.
extraNote: Games are non-refundable but rescheduling or store credit available if cancelled at least 3 hours before game time. · Arrive 15 minutes early; late arrivals over 15 minutes may not be allowed to play. · No pictures or video allowed during the game. · No alcohol or food allowed in escape rooms; event room available for parties. · Entrance at the back of the building facing Bridge Ave under a bright blue awning; head down one flight of stairs to the lower level.
